Apple just announced its all-new smart home lineup at the Apple Welcome Home Event 2026! In this video, we break down the brand-new Apple HomeView smart display hub, featuring Siri AI personal context integration, iOS app support, Safari browsing, multi-user recognition, and Matter & Thread border router support. We also look at the new Apple TV 4K (4th Gen) powered by the A19 chip with AV1 decoding, far-field microphones, lost remote finder, and surround sound home theater pairing. Plus, the updated HomePod mini 2 with Sound Glow music visualizers and new Apple Home collection smart home accessories made in collaboration with LG and Schneider Electric, including smart cameras, doorbells, locks, and smart thermostats.
